name: Lawgical.vn
description:
Lawgical connects Claude to Vietnam's corpus of central legal documents — laws, codes, decrees, circulars, resolutions, and consolidated documents — collected from official state sources and updated daily.

Ask in Vietnamese (or English) and get answers grounded in the source text, always with citations down to the specific article (Điều) and clause (Khoản), plus each document's validity status so you can verify for yourself. Instead of answering from memory — where a model can invent article numbers or quote text that's no longer in force — Lawgical requires the AI to retrieve directly from the original documents.

Key features:

Search legal documents by topic, returning verified article/clause citations
Read the full text of any document (laws, decrees, circulars, resolutions, and more)
A corpus updated daily — including newly issued decrees
Connects via OAuth — no API key needed
Your conversation never passes through Lawgical; the server receives only the search terms

Lawgical is a research aid, not a substitute for advice from a licensed attorney.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lawgical.vn to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lawgical.vn to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://legal.lawgical.vn/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lawgical.vn MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lawgical.vn provides these MCP tools: check_compliance, get_account_status, get_document, get_laws, get_summary, and search_legal_docs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lawgical.vn?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lawgical.vn in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
Lawgical.vn requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lawgical.vn is developed by Lawgical.vn. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
